timing: After first frozen Mac native observation, before first CI replay. This policy does not change first source/input/freezes, truth, metrics or routing thresholds.
well_separated: Preserve exact pair order if saved score gap exceeds the sum of both saved epsilons.
exact: 272 Got including callbacks, stop and unused slots
full candidate permutations, exact stable sort from each platform own scores
own costs/oracles/counts recomputed from complete own trace
near_ties: Keep actual float scores and actual exact stable order. Report changed orders/checks. Never epsilon-sort, coerce or replace first saved metrics.
artifacts: Keep first bounded stdout/stderr/status before acceptance in runner.temp; upload always on each OS. Runtime timeout/output bounds unchanged.
